scope: isolated local clean-copy reproduction; not independent third-party review
method: copy the public_alpha directory into a fresh temporary directory
create a fresh Python virtual environment with preinstalled offline build requirements
build and install anvil-public-alpha from the copied pyproject
run the copied release verifier after installation
run installed encode, verify, and benchmark commands on the copied synthetic fixture

preserved_failure.cause: fresh environment lacked the wheel build helper
preserved_failure.resolution: document the offline build prerequisite and rerun with preinstalled setuptools>=68 and wheel

claim_boundary: This proves local clean-copy reproducibility of AVP1. It is not an independent review, AVD2 reproduction, or production qualification.
